Fixture: every indented line below has to be refused by the rule
no-suite-source-header in .github/invariants.txt.

This file is excluded from the scan of the tree, because it holds the violation
on purpose. What it proves is that the rule still bites, which nothing else in
the run would notice: the tree is clean either way, so a pattern that lost an
alternative would go green over it.

The lines are the banner an upstream source file carries, in both of the comment
styles the suite writes it in, read at the version #5 pins. The accented name in
the upstream copyright line is not reproduced, because the rule does not read it
and a fixture carries nothing it does not need.

    *   This file is part of the FreeCAD CAx development system.              *
    # *   This file is part of the FreeCAD CAx development system.            *
    *   for detail see the LICENCE text file.                                 *
    # *   for detail see the LICENCE text file.                               *

The second alternative is the one the effort went into. Not every file upstream
carries the first sentence: the machining module's Python files, which are the
ones this project would be most tempted to lift from, carry the licence line and
not the sentence. A rule written to the sentence alone walks past exactly the
directory it most needs to cover.

Every other line in this file is prose and the rule has to match none of it,
which the run also asserts: it compares the line numbers that matched against
the line numbers that are indented and requires the two sets to be equal.
